integrity.source_anchor: Angel, Holroyd, Hutchcroft and Levy, arXiv:1802.07142v1, publicly released 2018-02-20.
integrity.statement: All finite-n covariances follow from Mallows inversion enumeration and entry conditioning; limiting claims follow by analytic expansion.

scientific_limitations: Only fixed-point pairs at positions (1,2) and (1,n) are classified; no all-position covariance assertion.
The weak-bias limits hold for fixed scaling constants, not arbitrary parameter paths.
Finite exact checks corroborate formulas but do not replace the proof for all n.
Historical priority remains subject to further primary-literature examination.
title: A sharp boundary fixed-point dependence transition in Mallows permutations
